title: Pack, fsck, GC, Vacuum
summary: Exercise the maintenance plane that keeps a content-addressed repository inspectable and repairable over time.
whySQLiteFallsShort: SQLite can validate page-level integrity, but it does not provide Git-like reachability, cruft quarantine, reflog-aware GC, and pack management as first-class maintenance primitives.
SydraDB exposes maintenance as repository-native commands instead of requiring opaque vendor tooling around a monolithic file.
The fsck, gc, and vacuum surface lets storage engineering validate behavior as the core engine changes rapidly.

steps.title: Pack reachable loose objects
steps.summary: Seal reachable loose objects into a pack set without collapsing older active packs.

steps.title: Validate and repair derivable metadata
steps.summary: Run fsck with repair enabled to validate graph integrity and rebuild safe side indexes when needed.

steps.title: Measure reachability and cruft handling
steps.summary: Dry-run reflog-aware GC to see what would be quarantined or pruned without mutating the repository.

steps.title: Run one-shot maintenance
steps.summary: Execute vacuum as the combined integrity, packing, expiry, and GC path for the repository.
